# AI Economy

AI Economy is an Australian AI consultancy founded by Sarah Balmer. The business helps organisations cut through AI overwhelm and put AI to work with measurable results.

Sarah Balmer is a LinkedIn Top Voice for AI with more than 25 years of experience helping businesses simplify the complex. AI Economy applies that practical lens to artificial intelligence.

## What AI Economy does

AI Economy provides three core services:

**AI Consultancy** — Bespoke strategy, workshops, and masterclasses that help business leaders build a clear AI roadmap tied to their commercial goals.

**Priority AI (AI Diagnostic)** — An 81-question diagnostic that maps AI opportunity against payroll and department data to identify where AI delivers the highest ROI. Takes 14–20 minutes to complete.

**AI Visibility Ranking (GEO Audit)** — An audit that identifies whether a business is appearing in AI-generated search answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Bing Copilot. GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimisation.

## Products

**Sarah Speaks** — Practical AI training workshops for business leaders and teams. Skills designed to be used immediately.

**Agent Alice** — A marketing agent that repurposes content, matches brand voice, and builds SEO and GEO-ready campaigns.

**Gatha.ai** — An AI product in development.

## The AI Economy model

The AI Economy approach follows three phases:

1. Discover — identify where AI will deliver the highest return using diagnostics and opportunity mapping
2. Train — build team capability through practical workshops and leadership programmes
3. Activate — implement tools, automate workflows, and establish AI visibility in search and AI engines

## Key claims and evidence

78% of organisations already use AI in at least one business function (McKinsey, 2025).
59% of professionals say AI literacy is now essential for career growth (DataCamp, 2026).
74% of enterprises say AI is already delivering measurable business value (Deloitte, 2026).
